responsibility: This file implements functionality shared by the C and Objective-C front ends, especially language hooks and diagnostics formatting. It provides common initialization, rules for warnings on noreturn and unused globals, a C-family tree printer for %D/%E/%F/%T/%V diagnostic formats, type pretty-printing that can show typedef-stripped “aka” forms, alias-set and type-compatibility hooks, and other shared semantic hooks such as C linkage and variably modified type queries.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file provides the executable shared C/Objective-C behavior behind the common layer, implementing routines such as c_objc_common_init, diagnostic/tree printing, aliasing, and type-compatibility hooks; gcc/c/c-objc-common.h instead is the macro configuration header that maps lang_hooks slots to those shared routines.
